course_name_en: Internet of Things and Information Systems (IOT)
prerequisites: IT fundamentals of the Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering

learning_outcomes.text: Describe the architecture and fundamental components of an IoT system.
Identify various application areas of IoT technologies and evaluate their benefits.
Select and integrate suitable sensors and actuators for specific IoT applications.
Understand the differences and application possibilities of communication technologies such as WLAN, Bluetooth, Zigbee or LoRa.
Classify and use network protocols such as HTTP, MQTT and CoAP.
Develop and program simple IoT applications.
Explain and assess the OWASP Top 10 security risks for IoT devices.
Explain the architectural structure of typical information systems.
Understand databases as the foundation of information systems.
Use web-based APIs of database systems.
Use SQL as a query language.
Know SAP solutions as an example of industrial information systems.
Know network communication possibilities of distributed systems.
Be familiar with the basics of IT security.

syllabus_topics: IoT fundamentals: definition, application areas, architectures
Security aspects in computer networks and IoT systems
Examples and use of industrial information systems
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the written exam (grade).
